purpose: The same trip with the renter's own E-ZPass, which should beat every company product.
assumptions: Saturday 21 November 2026, depart 10:00 Eastern, return 18:00 Eastern the same day, so the rental is 1 day.
The only tolled facility is the George Washington Bridge, eastbound into New York. The Port Authority tolls only that direction, so the return leg is free.
The car reaches the bridge within minutes, before 11:00, which is the weekend off peak window. E-ZPass off peak is 14.79. Tolls by Mail is 23.30 at all hours.
Washington Heights is north of 60th Street, outside the congestion relief zone, so congestion is 0.
The toll is crossed on 1 day, so a fee charged per usage day is charged once.
Rental base rates are placeholders of 100.00 per company, not quotes. They only fix the rental line so it cannot vary.
With a personal tag the toll is the E-ZPass off peak rate 14.79 and no program fee, which is below every company candidate above.

sources.source: PANYNJ tariff effective 4 January 2026, as recorded in data/seeds/SOURCES.md, Port Authority section
